Subject: Cerulean Health: MSA redlines & security exhibit playbook

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Attached is our annotated MSA with a few redlines focused on the security exhibit and audit language. A couple of asks up front:

- Can you confirm what your standard SOC 2 scope covers (infrastructure, control environment, logging)?
- We need clarity on pen test language — will Redwood accept third-party reports and can BlackPeak be the vendor?
- Procurement prefers a predictable evidence cadence (monthly snapshots + quarterly deeper evidence). Does that align with your standard ops?

Attached: Cerulean_MSA_Redlines.docx (redlines + procurement checklist).

Jordan

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cerulean Health: MSA redlines & security exhibit playbook

Jordan — thanks for the redlines. I pulled the team together (legal + security) and we sketched a short playbook to get the MSA/Order Form to an agreed state quickly. High-level:

- SOC 2: Redwood's SOC 2 Type II covers production infra and data processing pipelines for hosted endpoints; it includes logging, access controls, and change management. We can provide the SOC 2 report and bridge letter where applicable.
- Pen test: We accept third-party reports; BlackPeak is an approved vendor for us. We prefer agreed test windows and a limited-scope statement-of-work (SOW) to avoid broad, disruptive scans.
- Evidence cadence: We can do a hybrid cadence — monthly operational snapshots (logs, sampling of config, incident summaries) plus quarterly pen test coordination; if procurement needs more frequent artifacts for onboarding we can provide a short-term ramp (first 90 days weekly snapshots).

Next steps I propose: 30-min sync with procurement + BlackPeak to align scope, and legal to exchange a redlined audit clause. I've uploaded our draft security exhibit for your review (Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v1.pdf).

Would Wednesday (17th) or Thursday (18th) afternoon PT work for a short call?

Best,
Soojin
Head of Customer Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v1.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@ceruleanhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cerulean Health: MSA redlines & security exhibit playbook

Jordan / Soojin — quick note from legal on the MSA audit clause. We're generally amenable to audit rights but need to protect customer operations and minimize disruption. Proposed redline (summary):

- Inspection frequency: Limited to once per 12 months for full on-site inspections, with exception for regulatory/legal reasons.
- Remote evidence: Parties may request specific evidence items no more than once per calendar quarter; Redwood will provide agreed artifacts (SOC 2 report, log extracts, attestation) within 10 business days.
- Scope: Tests and access limited to systems processing Cerulean data; no arbitrary access to unrelated tenants.
- Notice window: 30 days for scheduled penetration tests; emergency access only with court order or mutually agreed escalation.

I attached a short snippet with suggested wording (MSA_Audit_Clause_snippet.docx). If Cerulean needs more permissive language we can escalate to legal leadership, but turnaround may be slower.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MSA_Audit_Clause_snippet.docx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@ceruleanhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 10:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cerulean Health: MSA redlines & security exhibit playbook

Thanks Karthik — that reads fair. A few clarifications from procurement/security:

- Cerulean requires SOC 2 scope to include logging and encryption-at-rest controls (KMS/HSM). Please confirm those are covered in Redwood's scope.
- For the pen test, Cerulean will engage BlackPeak (secops@blackpeak.io). Can Redwood nominate a technical contact to coordinate the SOW and test window?
- Preferred test window: late Jan -> early Feb (we can be flexible within that range).

Attached: ProcurementChecklist_Cerulean.xlsx with compliance gate items. Our security lead (cc'd via secops email once we share SOW) will coordinate technical details.

Jordan

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@ceruleanhealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 14:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cerulean Health: MSA redlines & security exhibit playbook

Jordan — looping in security ops details. Short answers and proposed operational doc:

- SOC 2: Confirmed — our SOC 2 Type II covers encryption (KMS-managed keys), key lifecycle controls, and logging across the production cluster. We'll share the report and a short mapping doc.
- Pen test coordination: Redwood technical contact: Neha Kapoor (me) — I'll coordinate with BlackPeak for windows and scope. We prefer a scoped SOW that lists targets, allowed testing types, and agreed blackout periods for maintenance.
- Evidence cadence: Proposed compromise: monthly operational snapshots (log excerpts, patching summary, configuration drift report) plus quarterly deeper artifacts (change logs, user access review). For the first 90 days post-signing we can provide weekly snapshots to accelerate onboarding.

I've put a template for the evidence bundle on our shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/cerulean-sec-exhibit and a DocuSign template for the exhibit. Also attached a simple Evidence_Template.csv to show fields we'll export.

If Cerulean is happy with the proposed cadence I'll coordinate a short triage call with BlackPeak this week.

-Neha
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Evidence_Template.csv

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Cerulean Health: MSA redlines & security exhibit playbook

Jordan — summarizing and next steps so we have an agreed thread:

1) Legal redlines: Karthik's suggested audit clause will be our starting point; Cerulean to confirm acceptability or provide alternative wording. Legal turnaround target: 3 business days once redlines are exchanged.

2) SOC 2 + evidence: Redwood will share the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a mapping doc to show how control families map to Cerulean requirements. Evidence cadence: monthly snapshots (operational), quarterly deeper artifacts; weekly snapshots for first 90 days if needed.

3) Pen test: Neha will be the technical lead to coordinate with BlackPeak (secops@blackpeak.io). Proposed test window: Jan 29 — Feb 9 (flexible) — if this works please confirm and provide BlackPeak's preferred SOW template.

4) Sync call: 30 minutes to lock scope and timelines. I'm proposing:
- Mon Jan 22, 10:00am PT
- Tue Jan 23, 2:00pm PT
Please confirm a slot and I'll send a calendar invite.

5) Deliverables: Redwood will provide updated security exhibit (v2) after we incorporate legal feedback and confirmation of BlackPeak SOW. We aim to have Order Form ready for signature within two business days of exhibit sign-off.

If that looks good Jordan, please reply with the preferred sync slot and confirm BlackPeak as the pen test vendor.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly on this.

Best,
Soojin
